insobriety.definition: n a temporary state resulting from excessive consumption of alcohol
insobriety.translation:
n. 不节制, 暴饮, 头脑不清醒
[法] 喝酒过度, 无节制, 头脑不清醒

insociability.definition:
n. The quality of being insociable; want of
   sociability; unsociability.

insociable.definition:
a. Incapable of being associated, joined, or connected.
a. Not sociable or companionable; disinclined to social
   intercourse or conversation; unsociable; taciturn.
insociable.translation: a. 不爱社交的, 不友善的

insofar.definition: r. to the degree or extent that

insofar as.translation: 在...的限度内, 在...的范围内, 到如此程度

insofar as....translation: 在...的限度内, 在...的范围内

insolate.definition: v expose to the rays of the sun or affect by exposure to the sun

insolated.translation: v. 暴晒（以漂白等）( insolate的过去式和过去分词 )

insolates.definition: v expose to the rays of the sun or affect by exposure to the sun
insolates.translation: vt. 暴晒（insolate的第三人称单数形式）

insolating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Insolate
insolating.translation: v. 暴晒（以漂白等）( insolate的现在分词 )

insolation.translation:
n. 日晒, 日光浴, 中暑
[医] 日射病, 中暑, 日光浴

insole.definition: n. the inner sole of a shoe or boot where the foot rests

insolence.definition: n. an offensive disrespectful impudent act
insolence.translation:
n. 傲慢, 无耻, 傲慢态度
[法] 无礼, 蛮横, 侮辱性言行

insolent.definition:
s marked by casual disrespect
s unrestrained by convention or propriety
insolent.translation:
n. 侮慢无礼的人
a. 粗野的, 无礼的, 侮慢的

insolently.translation: adv. 粗鲁地；无礼地；自傲地

insoles.definition: n. the inner sole of a shoe or boot where the foot rests
insoles.translation: n. 鞋内底, 鞋垫( insole的复数形式 )

insolubility.definition: n. the quality of being insoluble and difficult to dissolve in liquid
insolubility.translation:
n. 不溶解性, 不能解决
[化] 不溶性; 不溶解性

insoluble.definition:
a. (of a substance) incapable of being dissolved
a. admitting of no solution or explanation
s. without hope of solution
insoluble.translation:
a. 不能溶解的, 不能解决的
[医] 不溶解的

insoluble amidine.translation: [医] 淀粉不溶素, 淀粉经络质

insoluble enzyme.translation: [化] 固相酶; 固定化酶

insoluble tannal.translation: [医] 不溶性鞣酸铝, 硷性鞣酸铝(收敛剂)

insoluble tar.translation: [化] 沉淀焦油; 沉淀木焦油

insolubleness.definition:
n. The quality or state of being insoluble;
   insolubility.

insolubles.definition:
plural of insoluble
a. (of a substance) incapable of being dissolved
a. admitting of no solution or explanation
s. without hope of solution
insolubles.translation:
(insoluble 的复数) a. 不能溶解的, 不能解决的
[医] 不溶解的

insolvable.translation:
a. 不能解决的
[经] 不能偿还的(债务), 不兑现的(纸币)

insolvencies.translation: n. 无力偿还, 破产( insolvency的名词复数 )

insolvency.definition: n. the lack of financial resources
insolvency.translation:
n. 无力偿还, 破产
[经] 破产, 无力偿付, 不足抵偿债务

insolvent.definition: a. unable to meet or discharge financial obligations
insolvent.translation:
a. 无力偿还的, 破产的
n. 无力偿还者, 破产者

insolvent debtor.translation: [经] 无偿还能力的债务人

insolvents.definition:
plural of insolvent
a. unable to meet or discharge financial obligations
insolvents.translation:
(insolvent 的复数) a. 无力偿还的, 破产的
n. 无力偿还者, 破产者

insomnia.definition: n. an inability to sleep; chronic sleeplessness
insomnia.translation:
n. 失眠症
[医] 失眠[症]

insomniac.definition:
n. someone who cannot sleep
s. experiencing or accompanied by sleeplessness
insomniac.translation:
n. 失眠症患者
[医] 失眠患者

insomniacs.translation: n. 失眠症患者( insomniac的复数形式 )

insomnious.translation: a. 失眠的, 患失眠症的

insomuch.definition: r. to such an extent or degree; so
insomuch.translation: adv. 到这样的程度, 如此地, 因为, 由于

insouciance.definition: n the cheerful feeling you have when nothing is troubling you

insouciant.translation: a. 漫不经心的, 无忧虑的, 不在意的, 满不在乎的

insouciantly.translation:
漫不经心地
漠不关心地

insoul.definition:
v. t. To set a soul in; reflexively, to fix one's strongest
   affections on.
